summary.text: Cory Tomczyk is a Republican member of the Wisconsin State Senate who has represented District 29 since January 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He is a small business owner, and his general election opponent is Democrat Gillian Battino.

paragraphs.text: Cory Tomczyk was born in Wisconsin and lives in Mosinee.
His career experience includes owning a small business, and he has been involved with the Mosinee School Board, i-SIGMA, NAID, the Wausau Chamber of Commerce and The Hope Food Pantry.
In the 2025-2026 session, Tomczyk chairs the Transportation and Local Government Committee and is vice-chair of the Agriculture and Revenue Committee, according to Ballotpedia.

In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, he listed his key campaign messages as reducing taxes and returning surplus money to taxpayers, protecting gun rights and property rights, and keeping men out of women's sports, and he named taxation and transportation as policy areas he is passionate about.
